entities.name: Fuyumi Ono
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fuyumi Ono  is a Japanese novelist best known for writing The Twelve Kingdoms , which was adapted into a popular anime series. She is married to Yukito Ayatsuji, the author of the horror novel Another.
